compile_transformers_model: compile a transformers model type like llama with torch.compile optimizations and fused operations
create_new_function_from_source: create a new Python function from source code and write it to the compile cache directory
create_standalone_class: create a standalone class with an optimized forward method and optional torch.compile decorator
